players.product: VC (vapor chamber) thermal modules, thermal interface materials and liquid-cooling modules for 800G / 1.6T optical modules (connector liquid cold plates, NPO liquid cooling)

quarterly_data.signal: Asked by an investor whether it has signed a long-term supply agreement or other orders with Innolight, the company said on SZSE Interactive Easy that, building on the upstream-downstream industry-chain relationship between the two parties (the answer itself does not name Innolight), it continues technical exchange, solution development and customer validation of heat-dissipation products for high-speed optical modules, and that cooperation and order status are subject to its formal disclosures. It also said the profit contribution of its optical-module thermal and liquid-cooling work depends on customer validation, orders and subsequent deliveries.
